clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Darthalia sends word of victories against Hillsbrad's humans to Undercity's high command.

After the fighting across the Hillsbrad Foothills, High Executor Darthalia seals a dispatch recording victories against Hillsbrad's human defenders and the ruin of their positions. She addresses it to Varimathras, the dreadlord who advises Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. In the Royal Quarter, the report gives Forsaken leaders proof that Alliance enclaves south of Lordaeron can be broken, leaving northern garrisons free to face the Scourge.
